commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: ## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `node scripts/gen-problem-minimaps.mjs` writes 111 SVGs to the staging dir and no file is
written into `docs/problems/`.
- [ ] All 111 pages render a minimap from `static.tspsolver.com`; the 12 derived layouts still carry
a visible note and a distinct `alt`.
- [ ] The 94 maps that exist today are visually unchanged (spot-checked against `docs/problems/`
from before the change).
- [ ] `scripts/publish-minimaps.sh --dry-run` lists exactly 111 keys under
`tsplib/minimaps/v1/`, each with `image/svg+xml`, and needs no credentials.
- [ ] BATS coverage for the uploader mirroring `tests/e2e/publish-benchmarks.bats`: dry-run key set,
content type, `--only-changed` skipping an unchanged object, and the `cf`-then-`wrangler`
client selection.
- [ ] `publish-benchmarks.sh` still behaves identically after the R2 client moves to
`scripts/lib/r2.sh` (its BATS suite is the check).
- [ ] An e2e assertion that a problem page's minimap `` points at the published base URL and
has a non-empty `alt`.
- [ ] A verification step that reads the objects back (`cf r2 objects list --prefix`), as
`read-benchmarks.sh` does for shards.
- [ ] `docs/problems/` shrinks from 19.6 MB to under 200 KB, and the code diff (excluding the
quarantined deletion commit) is under ~600 lines.
- [ ] The deletion commit is verifiable without reading it: it touches only `docs/problems/*.md`,
no `<svg` remains, and the frontmatter gained exactly the minimap fields.
- [x] `node scripts/gen-problem-minimaps.mjs` writes 111 SVGs to the staging dir (`build/minimaps/`,
already git-ignored) and nothing into `docs/problems/`.
- [x] All 111 pages render a minimap from `static.tspsolver.com`; the 12 derived layouts carry the
visible note and a distinct `alt`.
- [x] The maps that exist today are visually unchanged — proved by pixel comparison rather than by
eye: master's inline SVG and the generated file rendered side by side at 340x200 differ in
- [x] `--dry-run` lists 111 keys under `tsplib/minimaps/v1/` plus `index.json`, each with its
content type, and needs no credentials.
- [x] BATS coverage for the uploader (12 tests): dry-run key set and content types, nothing uploaded
when the index matches, only changed objects, `--only`, an unreadable published index, a
tampered SVG refused against its index hash, a missing bucket, the exact `cf` argv including
`image/svg+xml`, the `wrangler` fallback, and both `--verify` paths.
- [x] `publish-benchmarks.sh` is unchanged in behaviour after the client moved to
`scripts/lib/r2.sh` — its 38 BATS tests pass.
- [x] An e2e assertion (3 tests, both browser projects) that the `` points at the published
base URL, has dimensions, lazy loading and a real `alt`; plus the derived caption and the
JSON-LD `image`. Not run by CI: it runs only `test:e2e:auth`
([[tasks/ci-runs-only-auth-e2e]]).
- [x] A read-back verification: `--verify` probes every expected object over its public URL and
exits non-zero listing the missing ones. It reads the CDN rather than the bucket listing
(`read-benchmarks.sh` keeps the `cf r2 objects list` form) because the CDN is what a page
actually fetches.
- [x] `docs/problems/` drops from 19.6 MB to **58 KB** (measured in bytes; `du` reports 444 KB
because 111 small files each round up to a 4 KB block). The code commit is 1,224 insertions /
95 deletions — 739 source and 485 tests. The "~600 lines" estimate covered the source and
ignored the coverage this task asked for.
- [x] The deletion commit is verifiable without reading it: only `docs/problems/*.md`, no `<svg`
remains, 111 pages gain exactly the two minimap fields and lose their bodies.
## Not done
- **The upload itself has not been run.** It needs `CF_R2_BUCKET` (`cf r2 buckets list`) and writes
production assets, so everything is verified against `--dry-run`. The merge order follows from
that: publish the objects, then merge the regeneration commit — the code commit alone is safe.
- No PNG/`og:image` pass, deferred as planned: the SVG needs no rasteriser in the pipeline and
social previews would.
- `scripts/gen-problem-pages.mjs` and the module read all nine `EDGE_WEIGHT_FORMAT` layouts, so the
page generator no longer disagrees with the Rust parser after
[[tasks/tsplib-all-edge-weight-formats]] — that follow-up is closed here.
## Context

changes.title: feat(web): serve problem minimaps from R2 instead of inlining them in the docs

commit.message:
task(web): complete minimaps as R2 assets

Records the measured results: the collection drops 19.6 MB -> 58 KB, the largest
page 6.2 MB -> 17.5 KB, the 94 existing maps are pixel-identical, and the
publisher has 12 BATS tests plus a read-back --verify. Notes that the upload
itself still needs a bucket and a go-ahead, and that the regeneration commit must
merge after the objects are published.
